# Cem Koyluoglu

> AI Engineer in Dublin, Ireland. Builds production LLM, RAG and computer vision systems; MSc Artificial Intelligence (First Class Honours, National College of Ireland). Open to AI/ML roles in Ireland and remote, and to freelance work.

This site is the canonical source for Cem Koyluoglu's professional profile, skills with evidence, project case studies, and Engineer's Notes (AI-assisted technical briefings on primary sources, automatically checked against those sources).

## Case studies

- [DeepFake Detection Framework](https://cemkoyluoglu.tech/work/deepfake-detection-framework): MSc dissertation, Attention-Enhanced EfficientNetB7, 97% accuracy on 10,000+ synthetic images
- [YouTube AI Summarizer](https://cemkoyluoglu.tech/work/youtube-ai-summarizer): Open-source Chrome extension with transcript-grounded chat
- [Ireland Expat Assistant](https://cemkoyluoglu.tech/work/ireland-expat-assistant): Custom GPT grounded in official Irish documents
- [Automated AI News Pipeline](https://cemkoyluoglu.tech/work/ai-news-pipeline): LLM cascade with quality gates behind this site's Tech News
